usedFor: Online sellers ship through Shiprocket, using “Create an Order” and “Generate Invoice” for each parcel.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Purchase Order” in inflow-inventory, then “Create an Order” in Shiprocket
bestTemplate.why: An updated purchase order becomes a shipping order, so dispatch needs no retyping.

watchOut: “Cancel Order” in Shiprocket cancels a created order, so check which order before it runs.
